message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the facts.

Facts: In 2012, defendant Wang2 gave cash 20,000 RMB to Wang3, the then director of Laiyang Health Bureau, to seek job adjustment. With Wang3's help, Wang2 was transferred from being director of Laiyang Yangjun Health Center to director of Laiyang Xuefang Center Health Center. In 2017, Wang2 voluntarily reported to procuratorate and confessed. Evidence confirms.

This is bribery: giving money to a public official to obtain a favor (job adjustment). The crime is 行贿 (giving bribe). Since the recipient is a public official (health bureau director), the charge is 行贿罪 (bribery). Also possibly “受贿” is for the official, not the briber. So only one charge: 行贿.

Check if any other charge like “滥用职权”? No, only bribery.

Thus answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
